publication.notes: The fetched source lives only in the public repository's ignored fixture tree at tests/fixtures/local/m6-clean-room/ and is not tracked. The specification derived from it is tracked at specifications/m6-foundation/RVL-042.md and is published in-tree in this public repository. The upstream material is not cleared for publication while the names surface is unresolved. The fetched tree includes the entry's binary assets (one sound file, two interface textures); they were not read as behaviour and nothing is shipped from them.
publication.reviewedBy: structure-reviewed 2026-09-05 by an independent Claude reader that had seen no upstream source; it read the specification first and then the counterpart's module list and public types to see whether a structural noun had crossed, after the counterpart was implemented; verdict: accepted; the specification's read/inferred/unknown markers and closing coverage statement were checked present. No human has read the specification in full.

rights.basis: MIT, read at the source rather than trusted from the inventory. Reading, modification and derivative works are permitted, which is what source-informed reimplementation requires. The counterpart must not copy source text; the specification written from this read carries no upstream identifier, which checks/verify-spec-identifiers.sh was run over and returned no finding.
MIT imposes no behavioural restriction and the inventory records behaviour as cleared and sourceUse as permitted for this entry.

Unchanged from the inventory. MIT does not grant trademark rights, so the project's own name, its mod id and its content identifiers remain unresolved. The specification therefore names nothing after the original, and no save-compatible identifier mapping is specified.

Two interface textures were fetched with the source and not read. The inventory records textures as cleared for this artifact and the licence reserves no asset separately. Nothing upstream is tracked or shipped; any counterpart art is rewritten from reference under policies/source-access.json and recorded in the package's assets-provenance.json.
The fetched tree contains no model file.

One sound file was fetched with the source and not played or read. The inventory records sounds as cleared for this artifact and the licence reserves no asset separately. Nothing upstream is tracked or shipped.
No branding material was fetched or read; the display name, logo and author identity are excluded regardless of licence status under policies/source-access.json.

sources.use: The upstream implementation, fetched as a source archive into the public repository's ignored fixture tree at tests/fixtures/local/m6-clean-room/tar/ and extracted alongside it, and read to write specifications/m6-foundation/RVL-042.md. Version correspondence to the pinned pack artifact -- exact: the build script at this revision declares version '1.21.1-8.0.15' and an archive base name that together produce the pinned artifact file name. The revision was located by reading the build-script history: the upstream project publishes no tag and no release, keeps one rolling development branch, and renamed that branch to a later game version in March 2026, so the 1.21.1 line has no branch of its own and this commit is the last on that branch before the later-version port began. No decompilation was performed and no jar was opened.

sources.use: Records the fetch. No fetch tool exists in either repository; the earlier rows were written by hand and this one was fetched with a plain archive download from the same host and appended in the same form, digesting the archive with sha256 as the existing rows do. Two of the pre-existing rows no longer match the archive currently on disk, so the digest binds the archive as fetched at the time above rather than asserting that the host re-serves identical bytes.
